scope: Source/specification audit plus generated AC1018 body-codec milestone; no production support claim

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files, v5.4.1
observations: The table entity has versioned formats and relies on an anonymous *T block for geometric results.
Section 20.4.96.1 describes the legacy body through R21, while explicitly leaving the AutoCAD 2008 cell changes incomplete.
R24 uses AcDbTableContent; the specification leaves its round-trip connection to TABLECONTENT and TABLEGEOMETRY undocumented.

decision: Keep DWG TABLE output refused until an exact version profile, complete entity/block/object graph, and transaction are implemented. Do not infer R24 layout from the partial reader or generalize one codec across versions.

observations: The trace captures encoded/resolved entity type 506, class AcDbTable, for two AC1021 TABLE frames; this is empirical for this file/profile only and does not establish the AC1018 class number.

The read publishes all 3,586 frames with zero entity/object parse failures, but TABLE semantic parsing becomes incomplete at CadValue flags 18137348, type 48, payload bit 278726; a second TABLE frame also stops at type 48.
Strict same-version DXF output stops at the unrelated FIELD/FIELDLIST serializer gate before writing, so no TABLE output/readback route was exercised.
physical_source_probe.disposition: Exclude this source as a complete TABLE writer witness. Do not use type 506 to hardcode an AC1018 class number or infer type-48 semantics. The user-provided DWG was not added to Git.

observations: The AC1018 source resolves AcDbTable to class number 528 for entity handle 0x4f2; this is a per-file empirical mapping, not a version-wide constant.
The typed TABLE body becomes semantically incomplete at undocumented R2007 cell override flags 0x40000.
The full source has 735 object frames and four object parse failures; strict output refuses the incomplete source disposition.
ac1018_source_screen.disposition: Not a complete TABLE writer witness; do not infer the unknown override payload or hardcode class number 528.

observations: Two AcDbTable entities resolve to class number 523 (handles 0x528 and 0xa35), differing from the other AC1018 source and disproving a single observed class ordinal as a sufficient registration rule.
Typed TABLE bodies become semantically incomplete at undocumented cell override flags 0x40020 and 0x40000.
The full source has 1,014 object frames and six object parse failures; strict output stops at the IMAGEDEF/reactor capture gate.
ac1018_source_screen.disposition: Not a complete TABLE writer witness; do not infer the unknown override payload or hardcode class number 523.

assertions: The parser records exactly the consumed override-flag and virtual-edge prefix as r2007-table-cell-overrides-unknown-flags with parseComplete=false.
The recorded bit start, bit size, count and parser cursor match the independently authored vector boundaries.
The TABLE remains semantically incomplete; the unknown payload is not skipped, decoded or admitted for output.
The same DRW_Table parser instance accepts a corrected supported AC1018 frame after the refusal and clears the prior incomplete range.
unknown_override_prefix_control.disposition: Diagnostic and retry evidence only; unknown override payload boundaries/semantics and physical TABLE writer support remain unresolved.

generated_ac1018_plain_text_encoder_cont.profile: one row, one column, one inline plain-text value-content cell
generated_ac1018_plain_text_encoder_cont.classNumberDisposition: test-only synthetic dispatch value; not a production class ordinal or version-wide mapping
assertions: The direct entity codec admits this generated bounded profile; implementation guards also restrict version, stream use, required handles, and modeled fields, but separate refusal/atomicity controls are still open.
The encoded entity body parses through DRW_Table::parseDwg with matching insertion point, column width, row height, plain-text cell value, BLOCK_RECORD handle and TABLESTYLE handle.
The parser cursor lands at the exact encoded body end and reads a following sentinel without consuming handle-stream bytes as body data.
generated_ac1018_plain_text_encoder_cont.disposition: Generated encoder/parser consistency only. No truncation matrix, refusal byte-preservation sweep, production class registration, physical AC1018 source-to-output comparison, *T compound graph, adapter transaction, independent readback, or native TABLE behavior is qualified. Keep dwgRW::writeTable refused.

assertions: Each rejected model leaves pre-seeded entity-body and handle buffers at their original bit counts.
The same DRW_Table instance succeeds after a table-override preflight refusal is corrected.
generated_ac1018_preflight_refusal_contr.disposition: Representative preflight atomicity only. Other retained-field exclusions and parser truncation at body/handle boundaries remain untested; it does not establish compound writer rollback or production output support.

first_candidate.profile: one row, one column, one plain text value-content cell
excluded: overrides, merges, fields and data links
nondefault style/color, cache, geometry, or retained raw subrecords
any unmodeled or incomplete semantic data
required_before_adapter_admission: remaining retained-field preflight controls and parser truncation at body/handle boundaries, plus corrected same-object retry
physical AC1018 plain-text source-to-output field comparison, or an explicit no-eligible-source disposition
production class resolution from the validated CLASS map rather than synthetic or copied class ordinals
complete *T BLOCK/BLOCK_RECORD ownership and TABLE style-reference disposition
compound writer atomic rollback, destination preservation, same-adapter corrected retry, and fresh readback
no unsupported cell/override field silently omitted

validation_policy: Focused generated controls and existing-source use only; no new downloaded DWG/DXF fixture is to be committed.
blockers: A generated-profile direct body codec exists, but no production class registration, adapter output route, or complete compound writer exists.
No complete AC1018 source-to-writer profile is currently recorded; the two screened AC1018 sources stop at undocumented 0x40000/0x40020 cell override flags.
Observed AC1018 AcDbTable class numbers differ by source (528 and 523); determine the supported CLASS-map resolution policy and never treat either ordinal as a version constant.
The only newly captured table class number is 506 in one AC1021 file; an AC1018 class number must be captured empirically before registering an AC1018 writer.
The AC1018 unknown-override control now captures only the known prefix; the physical payload span and meaning of 0x40000/0x40020 remain unresolved and must not be skipped or emitted.
The generated AC1018 encoder control uses synthetic class number 562 solely to exercise the body codec; production class resolution and physical interoperability remain open.
Direct codec truncation and no-partial-byte refusal controls remain open; the generated positive readback does not establish encoder failure atomicity.
The new generated refusal matrix is representative, not exhaustive; it covers unsupported version, table/cell overrides, extra columns, incomplete semantics and detached value handles only.
The available AC1021 table source is semantically incomplete at cell CadValue type 48 and cannot validate a complete output route.
R24+ TABLECONTENT/TABLEGEOMETRY relationship is outside the available ODA v5.4.1 layout and must remain refused.
